blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Martin Romualdez, former House Speaker and Leyte representative, is now at the New Quezon City Jail in Barangay Payatas on Monday night. Romualdez came from the Philippine General Hospital (PGH) where he was confined over the weekend. The former House Speaker was brought from PGH to the jail facility at 10:49 p.m. by the convoy of personnel from the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP).
